integrity_statement: An exact mathematical theorem with an independently replayable finite test suite; no external scientific audit or publication-priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Centered strongly convex quadratic; scalar multiplicative gradient noise, independent across stages and iterations, shared only across coordinates within one stage.
The tableau is classically second-order only for exact deterministic gradients; no stochastic order-two claim is made.
Mean-square convergence and per-iteration evaluation count only; no cost-normalized efficiency, nonlinear, or floating-point claims.
Priority may be affected by specialized earlier work on stagewise stochastic Runge–Kutta coefficients.
title: Stage-resampled second-order Runge–Kutta descent uniquely selects Heun
